title: "Noatmeal" hot cereal
summary: A warm, porridge-like bowl of hemp hearts, chia and flax simmered in almond milk, with cinnamon and vanilla.
steps: Put the hemp hearts, chia, flaxseed meal, coconut, almond milk, cinnamon and salt in a small saucepan.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring, and cook 3–4 minutes until thickened.
Take off the heat, stir in the erythritol and vanilla and let stand 2–3 minutes; it keeps thickening.
Divide between two bowls and top each with a spoonful of almond butter.
tips: Loosen with a splash of almond milk if it sets too thick.
Mix a double batch of the dry ingredients and keep it in a jar for quick mornings.

origin.history: Grain porridges are eaten almost everywhere, but oat porridge is especially associated with Scotland, where oats grew well in the cool, wet climate and were a staple for centuries. This grain-free version imitates the texture with seeds that thicken as they absorb liquid.
